values.note: Sanilac County Parks rates page (2026 site): 30-amp water/electric/sewer $45 a night ($270 weekly, $810 monthly, $2,800 season), 50-amp $50 ($300 / $900 / $3,200); rustic (no utilities) $30; rustic cabin $90. No resident/non-resident split.

fees.source: https://sanilaccountyparks.com/evergreen-park/evergreen-park-rates/ (Nightly: Rustic No Utilities $30, 30-Amp Water • Electric • Sewer $45, 50-Amp $50, Rustic Cabin $90), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.sanilaccountyparks.com/evergreen-park/ ('121 Full Hook-up 30-Amp Sites', '22 Full Hook-up Pull-Thru 30/50-Amp Sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 157 full-hookup RV sites (121 back-in 30-amp, 14 pull-through 30-amp, 22 pull-through 30/50-amp) besides rustic sites (number not given) and 2 cabins.

Book online (LetsBonfire), by phone or in person; paid in full at booking. Reservations for the season open at 8 am on the first business day after New Year's. No refunds on holiday or special-event weekends.

booking.source: https://sanilaccountyparks.com/evergreen-park/evergreen-park-rules/ ('Reservations for a site or sites can be made by phone, in person or online', 'Reservations for the season begin at 8 am on the first business day after New Years.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Sanilac County park ~9 mi N of M-46 on M-53 (4731 N Van Dyke Rd, Cass City), beside the Cass River, with a swimming pond, kayak launch, mini golf and nature trails; grass/shaded sites, plus rustic sites and cabins. Weekly, monthly and seasonal rates too. --Claude
summary: Recorded fees $45 (30-amp full hookup) to $50 (50-amp), no non-resident rate; rustic $30 left out of the base. Confirmed 50-amp/water/sewer, pull-throughs, reservable online (LetsBonfire); added showers, dump, store, season May 1-Oct 31 (was May-Nov in the note), booking notes. Site count: the park page lists 157 full-hookup sites plus an unstated number of rustic sites, so 171 is left. Phone (989) 872-6600 confirmed.
